CLAUDE.md:42:When a Bukkit/Paper plugin invokes a method on a bridge stub that has no real implementation, the stub MUST call `StubCallLog.logOnce(pluginId, signature)`. On the first hit per `(plugin, signature)` pair, the shared `StubCallLog` emits a WARNING-level JUL line for server operators (server console only). Subsequent hits for the same `(plugin, signature)` are silent.
CLAUDE.md:44:The in-game broadcast sink is intentionally NOT installed by the Bukkit bridge — stub-call warnings stay in the server console so they don't spam every player's chat. When adding or hand-tuning a bridge facade, keep the `StubCallLog.logOnce` call in any method that remains a no-op; do not re-install the broadcast sink without explicit instruction.

AGENTS.md:110:- [bridge-plugin-events.md](bridge-plugin-events.md): BukkitPluginWrapper must dispatch PluginEnableEvent/PluginDisableEvent — Essentials's permissions handler swap depends on it
AGENTS.md:113:- [bridge-biome-class.md](bridge-biome-class.md): Biome MUST be an abstract class (EssentialsX 2.21.2 emits invokevirtual on Biome.name); BukkitWorldAdapter MUST implement RegionAccessor (PaperBiomeKeyProvider casts world). Either gap silently kills /tpr inside CompletableFuture.thenAccept
AGENTS.md:168:- v1-v2: `LoginC2SPacketV2`/`LoginS2CPacketV2` — no mapSeed/dimension fields.
AGENTS.md:236:- **LoginSuccess UUID changed**: String UUID -> binary UUID (2 longs). Requires `LoginSuccessPacketV735`.
AGENTS.md:261:- **LoginSuccess binary UUID**: 2 longs instead of String. `LoginSuccessPacketV735`.
AGENTS.md:292:- **Login sequence ordering**: ALL Netty versions: send S2C PlayerPosition AFTER chunks. The client uses PlayerPosition as the signal to exit the loading screen and start physics. Sending before chunks causes intermittent "spawned inside ground" when chunk collision data isn't ready yet. `SetChunkCacheCenter` (sent before chunks) tells 1.14+ clients which chunk to prioritize.
AGENTS.md:349:- **LoginSuccess gained strictErrorHandling**: boolean at end. `LoginSuccessPacketV766`.
AGENTS.md:350:- **SelectKnownPacks round-trip**: After LoginAcknowledged, server sends SelectKnownPacksS2CPacket(minecraft:core v1.20.5), client replies with SelectKnownPacksC2SPacket, then server sends RegistryData + UpdateEnabledFeatures + UpdateTags + ConfigFinish.
AGENTS.md:385:- **Online mode support**: Server currently only runs in offline mode. Need to add Mojang session server authentication (`sessionserver.mojang.com`) and a toggle (`onlineMode` setting). Add bot tests for both online and offline login flows.
AGENTS.md:390:- **LoginC2SPacket self-adaptive**: Four branches based on `protocolVersion >= 28/17/3` and `forceMapSeed`.

package com.rdforward.server.bridge;

public final class LoginBridge {
    private final Session s;
    public LoginBridge(Session s) { this.s = s; }
    public void onLoginStart(String name) {
        s.send(new WelcomePacket("Welcome, " + name));
        s.send(new LoginSuccessPacket(name));
        s.setState(Session.State.PLAY);
    }
}
